invariants.description: Nernst: E_Na = 1000 RT/F ln(Nao/Nai), E_K = 1000 RT/F ln(Ko/Ki) (mV)

Na amount changes exactly by the integrated Na flux of the connected channels: Vol (Nai - Nai0) = integral j_Na_total dt (here the Na leak flux) (harness: Na and K leak channels at a fixed V) Tolerance: 1e-6 of the integral plus 100 x the solver resolution of the concentration (rtol 1e-8 x |c|): the change over the run is small next to the concentration itself.
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs(Vol*(Nai - Nai[0]) - np.concatenate(([0.0], np.cumsum(0.5*(lNa__j_leak_Na[1:] + lNa__j_leak_Na[:-1])*np.diff(t)))))) <= 1e-6*np.max(np.abs(np.concatenate(([0.0], np.cumsum(0.5*(lNa__j_leak_Na[1:] + lNa__j_leak_Na[:-1])*np.diff(t)))))) + 100*1e-8*Vol*np.max(np.abs(Nai))

invariants.description: K amount changes exactly by the integrated K flux: Vol (Ki - Ki0) = integral j_K_total dt (here the K leak flux) Tolerance: 1e-6 of the integral plus 100 x the solver resolution of the concentration (rtol 1e-8 x |c|): the change over the run is small next to the concentration itself.
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs(Vol*(Ki - Ki[0]) - np.concatenate(([0.0], np.cumsum(0.5*(lK__j_leak_K[1:] + lK__j_leak_K[:-1])*np.diff(t)))))) <= 1e-6*np.max(np.abs(np.concatenate(([0.0], np.cumsum(0.5*(lK__j_leak_K[1:] + lK__j_leak_K[:-1])*np.diff(t)))))) + 100*1e-8*Vol*np.max(np.abs(Ki))
